integrity: The formula and all minimum deletion sets follow from a direct part-size degree argument. A finite exhaustive program checks 182 part-size profiles and all minimal deletion sets, but is not used as an infinite proof. Claims in a cited manuscript that disagree with small exact examples are not adopted.
scientific_limitations: Finite complete multipartite graphs, at least two nonempty parts and at least one nonsingleton part. Strong domination degrees are recomputed after deleting vertices. Proper nonempty residual graph only; the all-singleton complete-graph case is excluded. An equivalent published result may exist under another formulation; independent mathematical audit is not performed.
title: Complete multipartite strong-domination stability and all minimum changing deletions
